message: Live frame analysis completed with OpenAI vision.

spec.workflowSummary: A narrow internal invoice collection tracker: capture invoice due details from an email inbox, generate a copyable WhatsApp payment reminder, then record the UPI/bank transfer reference and mark the invoice paid.

sourceEvidence.observation: Screen title says "Invoice collection workflow". Email inbox card shows "Client payment follow-up", invoice INV-1042 sent to Apex Retail, amount due Rs 48,000, due date 28 May 2026.
WhatsApp card shows "Send payment reminder" with message beginning "Hi Nisha, sharing a reminder for invoice INV-1042...".
Bank note card shows "Mark invoice paid after transfer" with UPI received Rs 48,000, reference HDFC2431, invoice INV-1042.

steps.title: Capture invoice due details from email
steps.input: Invoice number, client name, amount due, and due date from the client payment follow-up email.
steps.output: Invoice collection record created or updated with status "Invoice sent" or "Reminder needed".

steps.title: Prepare WhatsApp payment reminder
steps.input: Invoice record with contact name, invoice number, and amount due.
steps.output: Copyable WhatsApp reminder message generated; user manually sends it and updates status to "Reminder sent".

steps.title: Record received transfer and mark paid
steps.input: UPI/bank transfer amount, payment reference, and invoice number from the bank note.
steps.output: Invoice record updated with payment amount, payment reference, and status "Paid".

entities.name: InvoiceCollection
entities.label: Invoice Collection Record
entities.description: Single-row tracker record for an invoice being followed up for payment.

actions: Create or update invoice collection record from email details
Record UPI/bank transfer amount and reference
painPoints: Invoice details, WhatsApp reminders, and bank/payment notes are handled in separate places.
Invoice number and amount must be copied accurately between email, WhatsApp, and payment notes.
Payment references need to be stored against the correct invoice before marking it paid.
Reminder status can be missed if it is only tracked manually.

messageTemplates.name: WhatsApp payment reminder
messageTemplates.body: Hi {{contactName}}, sharing a reminder for invoice {{invoiceNumber}} of Rs {{amountDue}}.

screens.name: Invoice Collection Table
screens.description: Spreadsheet-style list of invoice records showing client, invoice number, amount due, due date, status, and payment reference.

screens.name: Invoice Entry Form
screens.description: Form to capture invoice details from the email inbox: invoice number, client, amount due, and due date.

screens.name: Invoice Detail
screens.description: Single invoice view for checking due details, reminder status, and recorded payment information.

screens.name: WhatsApp Reminder Templates
screens.description: Copyable message template populated from the selected invoice record. No WhatsApp API integration.

screens.name: Record Payment Form
screens.description: Form to enter received amount and payment reference from a bank note and mark the invoice paid.

validationRules.message: Payment amount received must be numeric.
Payment reference is required when marking an invoice Paid.

clarifyingQuestions.question: Should the tracker store WhatsApp phone numbers, or only the contact name used in the reminder?
clarifyingQuestions.defaultAnswer: Only contact name for MVP because no phone number is visible in the sampled frames.

clarifyingQuestions.question: Should a paid date be captured manually?
clarifyingQuestions.defaultAnswer: Omit manual paid date for MVP because the sampled frames only show payment amount, reference, and invoice number.

clarifyingQuestions.question: Should exports be limited to the invoice collection table?
clarifyingQuestions.defaultAnswer: Yes, export only the Invoice Collection records shown in the tracker.
